messages:
Priya Shah: Quick async standup — GPU fleet provisioning / quotas.

Priya Shah: What I did: rotated AMS spot pool (prewarmed 8 GPUs), bumped us-central1 prewarm by +6, validated autoscaler patch #824 in staging.

Priya Shah: Blockers: GCP quota request for apac (INF-412) still pending; throttling on apac spot returns; need escalation. Also seeing elevated KV-cache miss rates on long-history requests.

Priya Shah: Today: monitor 11:00 UTC traffic spike, follow up with cloud quota team, run a scaled canary for model-x at 14:00 UTC.

Sam Torres: Thanks — I just opened an escalation with GCP (case 12345678). Put a note on INF-412. Will try to squeeze additional regional prewarm if they approve.

Sam Torres: Also — node maintenance in eu-west1 scheduled 02:00 UTC tonight. Avoid large batch rollouts during that window :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Jordan Lee: FYI autoscaler patch caused one canary pod to OOM yesterday. Logs show memory estimate off by ~20%. Raising PR to bump container mem to 48Gi: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/infra/pull/902

Mei Chen: Can we redistribute prewarm across AZs? us-central1-a is saturated. If we rebalance, we can reduce spot eviction impact.

Mei Chen: Quick command I used to check prewarm node counts:
```
kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=prewarm -o wide --namespace infra
```

Priya Shah: Good call. @Sam can you add us-central1-b/c to the prewarm rotation when quota clears? I can patch the scaler once quota is in.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: prewarm-scaler v1.12 deployed to staging at 2026-03-17T08:22:10Z

Jordan Lee: I'll hold the model-x canary until autoscaler mem bump is merged — ETA 1.5h.

Sam Torres: Escalation acked by GCP support; requesting temporary quota bump for apac to 24 GPUs. Will update INF-412 when confirmed.

Priya Shah: OK — blockers noted. I'll watch telemetry dashboards and post if we need an emergency spillover to eu-west1. /cc @Mei Chen @Jordan Lee

Mei Chen: ping — if quota doesn't land by 12:30 UTC, I'll flip prewarm to conservative mode (reduce burst target to 30%).

Priya Shah: Thanks all. Short standup done. :thumbsup:
